tool_args.rationale: Acquire the targeted long-horizon probe before fitting. A measurement near H = 20 can distinguish sustained positive gain from slow adaptation and constrain the forecast at H = 22.2.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter sink-coupled dual-horizon model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All five observations have H ≤ 0.48. Over that window, the slow adaptation term mainly constrains its amplitude-to-time-constant ratio, not the two parameters separately. Their separation matters at H = 22.2.
Finer trajectory sampling does not directly test whether the short-window positive gain reverses near the forecast horizon.
